MSH.name: Message Header
MSH.description: Defines the intent, source, destination and some specifics of the syntax of a message. Always the first segment of every HL7 message.

fields.name: Field Separator
fields.desc: Defines the character that separates fields. Literal value |

fields.name: Encoding Characters
fields.desc: Four characters in this order: component separator ^, repetition separator ~, escape character \, subcomponent separator &. Default: ^~\&

fields.name: Sending Application
fields.desc: Uniquely identifies the sending application among all other applications within the network enterprise.

fields.name: Sending Facility
fields.desc: Further identifies the sending application. Can be an organizational unit or department.

fields.name: Receiving Application
fields.desc: Uniquely identifies the receiving application among all other applications within the network enterprise.

fields.name: Receiving Facility
fields.desc: Further identifies the receiving application. Can be an organizational unit or department.

fields.name: Date/Time Of Message
fields.desc: Contains the date/time that the sending system created the message. Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS[.SSSS][+/-ZZZZ]

fields.name: Security
fields.desc: Used to implement a security check between applications.

fields.name: Message Type
fields.desc: Contains the message type, trigger event, and message structure for the message. E.g., ADT^A01^ADT_A01

fields.name: Message Control ID
fields.desc: A number or other identifier that uniquely identifies the message. Used to reference the message in acknowledgements.

fields.name: Processing ID
fields.desc: Used to decide whether to process the message as defined in HL7 application (real) processing rules. P=Production, D=Debugging, T=Training.

fields.name: Version ID
fields.desc: Matched by the receiving system to its own version to be sure the message will be interpreted correctly. Use 2.5.1 for this version.

fields.name: Sequence Number
fields.desc: Non-null value in this field implies that the sequence number protocol is in use.

fields.name: Continuation Pointer
fields.desc: Used to define continuations in application-level fields.

fields.name: Accept Acknowledgment Type
fields.desc: AL=Always, NE=Never, ER=Error/reject only, SU=Successful only. Table 0155.

fields.name: Application Acknowledgment Type
fields.desc: AL=Always, NE=Never, ER=Error/reject only, SU=Successful only. Table 0155.

fields.name: Country Code
fields.desc: Country of origin for the message. ISO 3166 two-character codes.

fields.name: Character Set
fields.desc: The character set for the entire message. Table 0211. Default is ASCII.

fields.name: Principal Language Of Message
fields.desc: Primary language of the message. Data type is CE in v2.5.1; it became CWE in v2.7.

fields.name: Alternate Character Set Handling Scheme
fields.desc: Alternate character set handling scheme. Table 0356.

fields.name: Message Profile Identifier
fields.desc: Uniquely identifies the HL7 application message processing rules for the message.

MSA.name: Message Acknowledgment
MSA.description: Defines the acknowledgment code and control information for the acknowledgment message. Always returned in an ACK message.

fields.name: Acknowledgment Code
fields.desc: AA=Application Accept, AE=Application Error, AR=Application Reject, CA=Commit Accept, CE=Commit Error, CR=Commit Reject. Table 0008.

fields.name: Message Control ID
fields.desc: The Message Control ID of the message being acknowledged (MSH-10 from the original).

fields.name: Text Message
fields.desc: DEPRECATED in v2.5. Human-readable text giving further detail on a non-AA response.

fields.name: Expected Sequence Number
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Sequence number the sender expected.

fields.name: Delayed Acknowledgment Type
fields.desc: Withdrawn in v2.5.1 (usage W). Do not populate.

fields.name: Error Condition
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Error condition.

EVN.name: Event Type
EVN.description: Used to communicate necessary trigger event information to receiving applications.

fields.name: Event Type Code
fields.desc: DEPRECATED in v2.3.1+. Redundant with MSH-9 trigger event.

fields.name: Recorded Date/Time
fields.desc: The date and time the event was actually recorded.

fields.name: Date/Time Planned Event
fields.desc: The date/time the event is planned to occur.

fields.name: Event Reason Code
fields.desc: Table 0062. Describes the reason for the event. E.g., 01=Patient request, 02=Physician order, 03=Census management.

fields.name: Operator ID
fields.desc: The login of the person who entered the event. Used for audit.

fields.name: Event Occurred
fields.desc: The date and time the event actually occurred.

fields.name: Event Facility
fields.desc: Identifies the facility where the event occurred.

PID.name: Patient Identification
PID.description: Used by all applications as the primary means of communicating patient identification information. Contains all demographics. The most important segment in HL7 v2.

fields.name: Set ID - PID
fields.desc: For first occurrence of PID in a message, the value 1 is used.

fields.name: Patient ID
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Retained for backward compatibility. External patient ID.

fields.name: Patient Identifier List
fields.desc: Primary patient identification. CX components: ID^Check Digit^Check Digit Scheme^Assigning Authority^Identifier Type Code. Identifier Type Codes: MR=Medical Record, PI=Patient Internal ID, SS=SSN, DL=Driver's License.

fields.name: Alternate Patient ID - PID
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Third party identifiers for this patient.

fields.name: Patient Name
fields.desc: Legal name. XPN: Family^Given^Middle^Suffix^Prefix^Degree^Name Type. Name Type L=Legal, A=Alias, N=Nickname, P=Name of Partner/Spouse, M=Maiden.

fields.name: Mother's Maiden Name
fields.desc: Family name under which the mother was born.

fields.name: Date/Time of Birth
fields.desc: Patient's date and time of birth. Format: YYYYMMDD[HHMM[SS[.SSSS]]][+/-ZZZZ].

fields.name: Administrative Sex
fields.desc: Table 0001. F=Female, M=Male, O=Other, U=Unknown, A=Ambiguous, N=Not applicable.

fields.name: Patient Alias
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Other names used by the patient.

fields.name: Race
fields.desc: Table 0005. Patient's race. E.g., 1002-5=American Indian or Alaska Native, 2028-9=Asian, 2054-5=Black, 2076-8=Native Hawaiian, 2106-3=White.

fields.name: Patient Address
fields.desc: Mailing and home addresses. XAD: Street^Other^City^State^Zip^Country^Address Type. Address types: H=Home, B=Business, M=Mailing, BA=Bad address.

fields.name: County Code
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Use PID-11 (address) county/parish instead.

fields.name: Phone Number - Home
fields.desc: Patient's home phone number(s). XTN: [unused]^Telecom Use^Equipment Type^Email^Country Code^Area Code^Local Number^Extension^...

fields.name: Phone Number - Business
fields.desc: Patient's business telephone number(s).

fields.name: Primary Language
fields.desc: Patient's primary spoken language. ISO 639 codes.

fields.name: Marital Status
fields.desc: Table 0002. A=Separated, B=Unmarried, C=Common law, D=Divorced, E=Legally separated, G=Living together, I=Interlocutory, M=Married, N=Annulled, O=Other, P=Domestic partner, R=Registered domestic partner, S=Single, T=Unreported, U=Unknown, W=Widowed.

fields.name: Religion
fields.desc: Table 0006. Patient's religion.

fields.name: Patient Account Number
fields.desc: Patient account number assigned by accounting to which all charges, payments, etc. are recorded.

fields.name: SSN Number - Patient
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Social Security Number. Use PID-3 with identifier type SS.

fields.name: Driver's License Number - Patient
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Driver's license number.

fields.name: Mother's Identifier
fields.desc: Used as a link field for newborns.

fields.name: Ethnic Group
fields.desc: Table 0189. 2135-2=Hispanic or Latino, 2186-5=Not Hispanic or Latino, U=Unknown.

fields.name: Birth Place
fields.desc: Free-text description of patient's birth place.

fields.name: Multiple Birth Indicator
fields.desc: Y=Yes, N=No. Indicates if this patient was part of a multiple birth.

fields.name: Birth Order
fields.desc: Birth order for multiple births. 1=First, 2=Second, etc.

fields.name: Citizenship
fields.desc: Citizenship of the patient. ISO 3166 codes.

fields.name: Veterans Military Status
fields.desc: Table 0172. Military status of the patient.

fields.name: Nationality
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Table 0212.

fields.name: Patient Death Date and Time
fields.desc: Date and time of patient death.

fields.name: Patient Death Indicator
fields.desc: Y=Yes, N=No. Indicates if the patient is deceased.

fields.name: Identity Unknown Indicator
fields.desc: Y=Yes, N=No. Indicates whether or not the patient's/person's identity is known.

fields.name: Identity Reliability Code
fields.desc: Table 0445. AL=Patient/Person Name is an Alias, UA=Unknown/Default Address, UD=Unknown/Default Date of Birth, US=Unknown/Default Social Security Number.

fields.name: Last Update Date/Time
fields.desc: Date and time when this record was last updated in the sending system.

fields.name: Last Update Facility
fields.desc: Identifies the facility of the last update to a patient record.

fields.name: Species Code
fields.desc: Table 0446. The species of the patient. Used in veterinary context.

fields.name: Breed Code
fields.desc: Table 0447. The breed of the animal. Used in veterinary context.

fields.name: Strain
fields.desc: An indication of a strain of an organism.

fields.name: Production Class Code
fields.desc: Table 0429. Veterinary only. BF=Beef, BR=Breeding, DA=Dairy, DR=Draft, DU=Dual Purpose, LY=Layer, MT=Meat, NA=Not Applicable, OT=Other, PL=Pleasure, RA=Racing, SH=Show, U=Unknown.

PV1.name: Patient Visit
PV1.description: Used by Registration/ADT applications to communicate information on an account or visit-specific basis.

fields.name: Set ID - PV1
fields.desc: Sequence number of this segment. For first occurrence: 1.

fields.name: Patient Class
fields.desc: Table 0004. B=Obstetrics, C=Commercial Account, E=Emergency, I=Inpatient, N=Not Applicable, O=Outpatient, P=Preadmit, R=Recurring Patient, U=Unknown.

fields.name: Assigned Patient Location
fields.desc: PL: Point of Care^Room^Bed^Facility^Location Status^Person Location Type^Building^Floor^Location Description^Comprehensive Location Identifier^Assigning Authority. The patient's assigned bed/location.

fields.name: Admission Type
fields.desc: Table 0007. A=Accident, C=Elective, E=Emergency, L=Labor and Delivery, N=Newborn, R=Routine, U=Urgent.

fields.name: Preadmit Number
fields.desc: Uniquely identifies the patient's pre-admission account.

fields.name: Prior Patient Location
fields.desc: Previous patient location for transfers.

fields.name: Attending Doctor
fields.desc: Attending physician. XCN: ID^Family^Given^Middle^Suffix^Prefix^Degree^Source Table^Assigning Authority^Name Type.

fields.name: Referring Doctor
fields.desc: Referring physician.

fields.name: Consulting Doctor
fields.desc: DEPRECATED.

fields.name: Hospital Service
fields.desc: Table 0069. The treatment or type of surgery the patient is scheduled for.

fields.name: Temporary Location
fields.desc: Temporary patient location.

fields.name: Admit Source
fields.desc: Table 0023. 1=Physician referral, 2=Clinic referral, 3=HMO referral, 4=Transfer from hospital, 5=Transfer from SNF, 6=Transfer from another health care facility, 7=Emergency room, 8=Court/law enforcement, 9=Information not available.

fields.name: Ambulatory Status
fields.desc: Table 0009. A0=No functional limitations, A1=Ambulates with assistive device, A2=Wheelchair/stretcher bound, A3=Comatose, A4=Disoriented, A5=Vision impaired, A6=Hearing impaired, A7=Speech impaired, A8=Non-English speaking, A9=Functional level unknown, B1=Oxygen therapy, B2=Special equipment, B3=Amputee, B4=Mastectomy, B5=Paraplegic, B6=Pregnant.

fields.name: VIP Indicator
fields.desc: Table 0099. Indicates whether patient is considered a VIP.

fields.name: Admitting Doctor
fields.desc: Admitting physician.

fields.name: Patient Type
fields.desc: Table 0018. Site-defined patient type.

fields.name: Visit Number
fields.desc: Unique number assigned to each patient visit. Often called encounter number.

fields.name: Admit Date/Time
fields.desc: Date and time of admission.

fields.name: Discharge Date/Time
fields.desc: Date and time of discharge.

fields.name: Visit Indicator
fields.desc: Table 0326. A=Account Level, V=Visit Level.

ORC.name: Common Order
ORC.description: Used to transmit fields that are common to all orders (all types of services that are requested). ORC is REQUIRED in each ORDER group of ORM^O01 and ORR^O02. It is OPTIONAL in the ORDER_OBSERVATION group of ORU^R01 — a common misconception is that ORU requires it.

fields.name: Order Control
fields.desc: Table 0119. The function of the order segment. NW=New Order, CA=Cancel Order, DC=Discontinue Order, HD=Hold Order, RL=Release Previous Hold, RP=Order/Service Replace Request, RU=Replaced Unsolicited, SC=Status Changed, SN=Send Order Number, OK=Order Accepted, UA=Unable to Accept Order, UC=Unable to Cancel, UM=Unable to Discontinue, UH=Unable to Put on Hold, UR=Unable to Release, UX=Unable to Change, AF=Order/Service Refill Request Approval, NA=Number Assigned, RE=Observations/Performed Service to Follow, OR=Released as Requested, RF=Refill Order Request, PA=Parent Order.

fields.name: Placer Order Number
fields.desc: Identifier of the order placed by the placer application. EI: Entity Identifier^Namespace ID^Universal ID^Universal ID Type.

fields.name: Filler Order Number
fields.desc: Order number assigned by the filling application (e.g., RIS accession number in radiology).

fields.name: Placer Group Number
fields.desc: Allows an order placing application to group sets of orders together.

fields.name: Order Status
fields.desc: Table 0038. Status of the order: A=Some, but not all, results available, CA=Order was canceled, CM=Order is completed, DC=Order was discontinued, ER=Error, hold order, HD=Order is on hold, IP=In process, unspecified, RP=Order has been replaced, SC=In process, scheduled.

fields.name: Quantity/Timing
fields.desc: DEPRECATED in v2.5. Replaced by ORC-7 and ORC-8 in earlier versions; timing now in TQ1/TQ2 segments.

fields.name: Date/Time of Transaction
fields.desc: Date and time the current transaction enters the order.

fields.name: Entered By
fields.desc: Person who placed the request.

fields.name: Verified By
fields.desc: Person who verified the order.

fields.name: Ordering Provider
fields.desc: Provider who ordered the procedure.

fields.name: Enterer's Location
fields.desc: Location where the order was entered.

fields.name: Call Back Phone Number
fields.desc: Phone number to call when the order is completed.

fields.name: Order Effective Date/Time
fields.desc: Date/time that the changes indicated by the order control code take effect.

fields.name: Order Control Code Reason
fields.desc: Explanation or reason codes for the order event.

fields.name: Entering Organization
fields.desc: Organization that entered the order.

fields.name: Entering Device
fields.desc: Physical device (terminal, etc.) used to enter the order.

fields.name: Action By
fields.desc: Provider responsible for the action.

fields.name: Ordering Facility Name
fields.desc: Name of the facility with which the ordering provider is associated.

fields.name: Ordering Facility Address
fields.desc: Address of the facility associated with the ordering provider.

OBR.name: Observation Request
OBR.description: Used to transmit information specific to an order for a diagnostic study or observation. In radiology: the procedure request. OBR-18 is the Accession Number. OBR-25 is Result Status.

fields.name: Set ID - OBR
fields.desc: For the first order transmitted, the sequence number shall be 1.

fields.name: Placer Order Number
fields.desc: Identifier assigned by the placer. Same as ORC-2.

fields.name: Filler Order Number
fields.desc: Identifier assigned by the filler (RIS). Same as ORC-3.

fields.name: Universal Service Identifier
fields.desc: Identifies universally the service to be performed. Contains the procedure code. E.g., CT abdomen, MRI brain. Use CPT-4, LOINC or site-defined codes. Data type is CE in v2.5.1 (CWE from v2.7).

fields.name: Priority
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Kept for backward compatibility.

fields.name: Requested Date/Time
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Date/time the order was requested.

fields.name: Observation Date/Time
fields.desc: Observation start date/time. In radiology: when the procedure began.

fields.name: Observation End Date/Time
fields.desc: End date and time of observation period.

fields.name: Collection Volume
fields.desc: For laboratory: quantity of specimen collected.

fields.name: Collector Identifier
fields.desc: Person who collected the specimen.

fields.name: Specimen Action Code
fields.desc: Table 0065. Action to take with the specimen. A=Add ordered tests, G=Generated order, L=Lab to obtain specimen from patient, O=Specimen obtained by service, P=Pending specimen, Q=Specimen obtained by lab, R=Revised order, S=Schedule the tests, T=Transfer specimen.

fields.name: Danger Code
fields.desc: Code and/or text indicating any special handling considerations for the specimen.

fields.name: Relevant Clinical Information
fields.desc: Additional clinical information about the patient or specimen to guide the filler. The clinical indication or reason for study.

fields.name: Ordering Provider
fields.desc: Provider who ordered the procedure. Same as ORC-12.

fields.name: Order Callback Phone Number
fields.desc: Phone number for results callback.

fields.name: Placer Field 1
fields.desc: User-defined placer field. In radiology, IHE RAD TF-2 maps the DICOM Accession Number (0008,0050) to OBR-18 for the Scheduled Workflow profile, and that is the most common convention. Be aware it is a convention, not a v2.5.1 requirement — some sites instead carry the accession in OBR-2, OBR-3 or ORC-3, so always confirm against the site's interface specification before mapping.

fields.name: Placer Field 2
fields.desc: Additional placer-defined field.

fields.name: Filler Field 1
fields.desc: Filler-defined field.

fields.name: Filler Field 2
fields.desc: Filler-defined field.

fields.name: Results Rpt/Status Chng - Date/Time
fields.desc: Date/time when the results were reported or status changed.

fields.name: Diagnostic Serv Sect ID
fields.desc: Table 0074. AU=Audiology, BG=Blood Gases, BLB=Blood Bank, CG=Cytogenetics, CH=Chemistry, CP=Cytopathology, CT=CAT Scan, CTH=Cardiac Catheterization, CUS=Cardiac Ultrasound, EC=Electrocardiac, EN=Electroneuro, GE=Genetics, HM=Hematology, ICU=Bedside ICU Monitoring, IMG=Diagnostic Imaging, IMM=Immunology, LAB=Laboratory, MB=Microbiology, MCB=Mycobacteriology, MYC=Mycology, NMR=Nuclear Magnetic Resonance, NMS=Nuclear Medicine Scan, NRS=Nursing Service Measures, OSL=Outside Lab, OT=Occupational Therapy, OTH=Other, OUS=OB Ultrasound, PAR=Parasitology, PAT=Pathology, PF=Pulmonary Function, PHR=Pharmacy, PHY=Physician (Hx. Dx. Rx.), PT=Physical Therapy, RAD=Radiology, RC=Respiratory Care (Therapy), RT=Radiation Therapy, RUS=Radiology Ultrasound, RX=Radiograph, SP=Surgical Pathology, SR=Serology, TX=Toxicology, URN=Urinalysis, VR=Virology, VUS=Vascular Ultrasound.

fields.name: Result Status
fields.desc: Table 0123. Required whenever OBX segments are present. O=Order received, specimen not yet received; I=No results available, specimen received, procedure incomplete; S=No results available, procedure scheduled but not done; A=Some but not all results available; P=Preliminary (a verified early result is available); C=Correction to results; R=Results stored, not yet verified; F=Final results (can only be changed by a corrected result); X=No results available, order canceled; Y=No order on record for this test (query response only); Z=No record of this patient (query response only). Note: M, N and W are NOT valid table 0123 values — they belong to OBX-11 / table 0085.

fields.name: Parent Result
fields.desc: Links to the parent order.

fields.name: Parent
fields.desc: Used to link child orders to parent orders.

fields.name: Reason for Study
fields.desc: Clinical indication for the study.

fields.name: Principal Result Interpreter
fields.desc: Person who analyzed the observation and identified the conclusion.

fields.name: Technician
fields.desc: Person who performed the observation.

fields.name: Scheduled Date/Time
fields.desc: Scheduled date and time for the study.

fields.name: Procedure Code
fields.desc: Unique identifier for the procedure. E.g., CPT code.

fields.name: Procedure Code Modifier
fields.desc: Contains the procedure code modifier to the procedure code.

OBX.name: Observation/Result
OBX.description: Used to transmit a single observation or observation fragment. In radiology: used for report text and measurements. Can contain text, numeric values, coded values, images, and more.

fields.name: Set ID - OBX
fields.desc: Sequence number for multiple OBX segments.

fields.name: Value Type
fields.desc: Table 0125. CE=Coded Entry, CWE=Coded with Exceptions, CX=Extended Composite ID, DT=Date, DTM=Date/Time, ED=Encapsulated Data, FT=Formatted Text, GTS=General Timing Specification, ID=Coded Value for HL7, IS=Coded Value for User-Defined, MO=Money, NA=Numeric Array, NM=Numeric, RP=Reference Pointer, SN=Structured Numeric, ST=String Data, TM=Time, TX=Text Data, XAD=Extended Address, XCN=Extended Composite ID, XON=Extended Composite Name for Organizations, XPN=Extended Person Name, XTN=Extended Telecommunications Number.

fields.name: Observation Identifier
fields.desc: Uniquely identifies the observation. Use LOINC codes when possible. E.g., 18782-3=Radiology Study Observation. Components: Identifier^Text^Name of Coding System^Alternate Identifier^Alternate Text^Name of Alternate Coding System. Data type is CE in v2.5.1 (CWE from v2.7).

fields.name: Observation Sub-ID
fields.desc: Distinguishes between multiple OBX segments with the same OBX-3. Used when a result has sub-components.

fields.name: Observation Value
fields.desc: Contains the value observed by the observation producer. Data type matches OBX-2. For text reports use FT (Formatted Text) or TX (Text Data).

fields.name: Units
fields.desc: Description of the units of measure for the result.

fields.name: References Range
fields.desc: Normal range for the value. Format: low-high, or >value, or <value.

fields.name: Abnormal Flags
fields.desc: Table 0078. L=Below low normal, H=Above high normal, LL=Below lower panic limits, HH=Above upper panic limits, <=(Less than), >=(Greater than), A=Abnormal, AA=Very abnormal, N=Normal, U=Significant change up, D=Significant change down, B=Better, W=Worse, S=Susceptible, R=Resistant, I=Intermediate, MS=Moderately susceptible, VS=Very susceptible.

fields.name: Observation Result Status
fields.desc: Table 0085. C=Record coming over is a correction and thus replaces a final result, D=Deletes the OBX record, F=Final results, I=Specimen in lab; results pending, N=Not asked; used only on queries where only certain results are requested, O=Order detail description only (no result), P=Preliminary results, R=Results entered, not verified, S=Partial results, U=Results status change to Final — results did not change, W=Post original as wrong, X=Results cannot be obtained for this observation.

fields.name: Date/Time of the Observation
fields.desc: Date and time the observation was performed.

fields.name: Producer's ID
fields.desc: Identifies the person who created this observation.

fields.name: Responsible Observer
fields.desc: Person responsible for verifying the observation.

fields.name: Observation Method
fields.desc: Method used for the observation.

fields.name: Equipment Instance Identifier
fields.desc: Identifies the device that produced the measurement.

fields.name: Date/Time of the Analysis
fields.desc: Date and time the observation was analyzed.

NTE.name: Notes and Comments
NTE.description: Used to send notes and comments associated with the adjacent segment. Can appear after multiple segment types.

fields.name: Set ID - NTE
fields.desc: Sequence number for multiple NTE segments.

fields.name: Source of Comment
fields.desc: Table 0105. L=Ancillary (filler) department, P=Orderer (placer) department, O=Other system.

fields.name: Comment
fields.desc: Free text comments. FT type allows embedded formatting (\H\ for highlight, \N\ for normal, \.br\ for line break).

fields.name: Comment Type
fields.desc: Table 0364. AI=Ancillary Instructions, AR=Ancillary Results, DR=Duplicate/Interaction Reason, GI=General Instructions, GR=General Results, PI=Patient Instructions, RE=Remark. Data type is CE in v2.5.1.

MRG.name: Merge Patient Information
MRG.description: Used in patient merging (ADT^A40). Contains prior patient identifier(s). The MRN in MRG-1 is the 'losing' or prior ID — all records under it should be merged into the patient identified in PID.

fields.name: Prior Patient Identifier List
fields.desc: Prior patient identifier list. Used during patient merges.

fields.name: Prior Alternate Patient ID
fields.desc: DEPRECATED.

fields.name: Prior Patient Account Number
fields.desc: Prior patient account number.

fields.name: Prior Patient ID
fields.desc: DEPRECATED.

fields.name: Prior Visit Number
fields.desc: Prior visit number.

fields.name: Prior Alternate Visit ID
fields.desc: Prior alternate visit number.

fields.name: Prior Patient Name
fields.desc: Prior patient name.

AL1.name: Patient Allergy Information
AL1.description: Transmits information about patient allergy or adverse reaction information.

fields.name: Set ID - AL1
fields.desc: Sequence number.

fields.name: Allergen Type Code
fields.desc: Table 0127. DA=Drug Allergy, EA=Environmental Allergy, FA=Food Allergy, LA=Pollen Allergy, MA=Miscellaneous Allergy, MC=Miscellaneous Contraindication, PA=Plant Allergy. Data type is CE in v2.5.1.

fields.name: Allergen Code/Mnemonic/Description
fields.desc: Uniquely identifies the allergy (allergen). Code and description of the allergy. Data type is CE in v2.5.1.

fields.name: Allergy Severity Code
fields.desc: Table 0128. MI=Mild, MO=Moderate, SV=Severe, U=Unknown. Data type is CE in v2.5.1.

fields.name: Allergy Reaction Code
fields.desc: Free text string for the allergic reaction experienced.

fields.name: Identification Date
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Date the allergy was identified.

DG1.name: Diagnosis
DG1.description: Contains patient diagnosis information of various types.

fields.name: Set ID - DG1
fields.desc: Sequence number.

fields.name: Diagnosis Coding Method
fields.desc: DEPRECATED.

fields.name: Diagnosis Code - DG1
fields.desc: Identifies the diagnosis. Use ICD-9-CM, ICD-10-CM, or SNOMED codes. Data type is CE in v2.5.1.

fields.name: Diagnosis Description
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Free text description of the diagnosis.

fields.name: Diagnosis Date/Time
fields.desc: Date and time when the diagnosis was made.

fields.name: Diagnosis Type
fields.desc: Table 0052. A=Admitting, W=Working, F=Final.

fields.name: Diagnosis Priority
fields.desc: Table 0359. 0=Not included in diagnosis ranking, 1=Principal diagnosis, 2-∞=For ranked secondary diagnoses.

fields.name: Diagnosing Clinician
fields.desc: Provider who made the diagnosis.

fields.name: Diagnosis Classification
fields.desc: Table 0228. C=Consultation, D=Diagnosis, M=Medication (antibiotic), N=Nursing Diagnosis, O=Order, P=Procedure, R=Radiology, S=Sign and Symptom, T=Test, I=Invasive procedure not classified elsewhere.

fields.name: Attestation Date/Time
fields.desc: Date the diagnosis was attested.

ZDS.name: Study Instance UID (IHE Extension)
ZDS.description: Non-standard Z-segment defined by IHE (Integrating the Healthcare Enterprise) in the Scheduled Workflow (SWF) profile. Carries the DICOM Study Instance UID in an HL7 ORM message, enabling the RIS to assign the UID before acquisition and communicate it to the PACS. Defined in IHE RAD TF Vol 2, transaction RAD-4.

fields.name: Study Instance UID
fields.desc: DICOM Study Instance UID (0020,000D). RP (Reference Pointer) data type with components Pointer^Application ID^Type of Data^Subtype. The UID goes in the first component; IHE examples populate the remainder as ^100^Application^DICOM. Example: 1.2.840.113619.2.1.1.322987881.621.736170080.681^100^Application^DICOM. The UID itself is limited to 64 characters by DICOM PS3.5 and must consist only of digits and dots.

ZDS.note: IHE RAD TF-2 defines exactly ONE field for ZDS. Segments in the wild that carry an accession number, procedure code or modality in ZDS-2 onward are site-local extensions, not part of the IHE definition.

IN1.name: Insurance
IN1.description: Contains insurance policy coverage information necessary to produce properly pro-rated and patient and insurance bills.

fields.name: Set ID - IN1
fields.desc: Sequence number.

fields.name: Insurance Plan ID
fields.desc: Uniquely identifies the insurance plan. Data type is CE in v2.5.1.

fields.name: Insurance Company ID
fields.desc: Uniquely identifies the insurance company.

fields.name: Insurance Company Name
fields.desc: Name of the insurance company.

fields.name: Insurance Company Address
fields.desc: Address of the insurance company.

fields.name: Plan Type
fields.desc: Table 0086. Type of insurance plan.

fields.name: Name Of Insured
fields.desc: Name of the insured person.

fields.name: Insured's Relationship To Patient
fields.desc: Table 0063. SEL=Self, SPO=Spouse, CHD=Child, OTH=Other, UNK=Unknown, MTH=Mother, FTH=Father, BRO=Brother, SIS=Sister, GRP=Grandparent. Data type is CE in v2.5.1.

fields.name: Company Plan Code
fields.desc: Table 0042. Identifies the specific medical benefit plan offered by the insurance company.

SCH.name: Scheduling Activity Information
SCH.description: Contains information about the scheduled appointment in SIU and SRM messages.

fields.name: Placer Appointment ID
fields.desc: Identifier assigned to the appointment by the placer application.

fields.name: Filler Appointment ID
fields.desc: Identifier assigned to the appointment by the filler application.

fields.name: Schedule ID
fields.desc: Identifier of the schedule this appointment is booked against.

fields.name: Event Reason
fields.desc: Reason this event occurred (why the appointment was booked, modified or cancelled). Data type is CE in v2.5.1.

fields.name: Appointment Reason
fields.desc: Table 0276. Reason the appointment is to take place. ROUTINE, WALKIN, CHECKUP, EMERGENCY, FOLLOWUP.

fields.name: Appointment Type
fields.desc: Table 0277. Type of appointment: Normal, Tentative, Complete.

fields.name: Appointment Duration
fields.desc: Duration of the appointment. Units given in SCH-10. Note: this is SCH-9, not SCH-11.

fields.name: Appointment Duration Units
fields.desc: Units of measure for SCH-9 Appointment Duration (e.g., min, hr).

fields.name: Appointment Timing Quantity
fields.desc: Start date/time and repeating interval of the appointment. TQ data type; retained in v2.5.1 for the SCH segment even though TQ is deprecated elsewhere in favour of TQ1/TQ2.

fields.name: Filler Status Code
fields.desc: Table 0278. Status of the appointment in the filler system: Pending, Waitlist, Booked, Started, Complete, Cancelled, Discontinued, Overbook, Noshow, Blocked, Deleted. Data type is CE in v2.5.1.

ERR.name: Error
ERR.description: Contains information about errors detected in the processing of HL7 messages. Replaces MSA-3 for error details.

fields.name: Error Code and Location
fields.desc: DEPRECATED. Error code and location.

fields.name: Error Location
fields.desc: Identifies the location in a message related to the identified error.

fields.name: HL7 Error Code
fields.desc: Table 0357. 0=Message accepted, 100=Segment sequence error, 101=Required field missing, 102=Data type error, 103=Table value not found, 200=Unsupported message type, 201=Unsupported event code, 202=Unsupported processing ID, 203=Unsupported version ID, 204=Unknown key identifier, 205=Duplicate key identifier, 206=Application record locked, 207=Application internal error.

fields.name: Severity
fields.desc: Table 0516. I=Informational, W=Warning, E=Error.

fields.name: Application Error Code
fields.desc: Application-specific error code.

fields.name: Application Error Parameter
fields.desc: Additional information to be used, together with the Application Error Code, to understand a particular error condition.

fields.name: Diagnostic Information
fields.desc: Information that may be used by help desk or system support personnel to diagnose a problem.

fields.name: User Message
fields.desc: The text message to be displayed to the user of the application where the error occurred.
